correctness.rationale: The allowable enclosing radius-R centers form B_{R-r}(0) intersect B_R(se_1) and are nonempty iff s<=2R-r. The exact hull boundary uses two radius-R spindle arcs plus the rear radius-r arc, so the Green-area formula gives A(s)=R²(pi-theta-phi)+r²theta-(R-r)s sin(theta). Strict nestedness and rotational invariance imply the inverse concentric-disk illumination profile. R-ball convexity of a radius-t disk holds iff t<=R. Expansions at theta≈pi and theta≈0 give the 3/2 onset and 1/2 terminal area-gap powers. Independent area evaluation at (R,r,s)=(2,1,1.5) gave excess 0.4805374189940421, agreeing with the earlier independently parameterized closed formula.
residual_risks: Numeric equality at representative finite radii is corroboration, not proof of continuous geometry.
